name: AI QA Copilot golden set
description: Build Bible §22 evaluation dataset, v1: 12 synthetic SaaS requirements spanning all seven §22 workflow categories (auth, search, checkout, payments, permissions, profile, upload). Each fixture carries a hand-authored QA oracle (the independent expected behavior, §19 S1.2) and a golden test suite — a competent model's reference output, validated by the §12 TestSuite schema. Pinned prompt: test-designer@1 (§31.6). Targets per §31.7. Consumed by the S1.4 eval runner and the S1.2 unit tests.

fixtures.title: Login with email and password
fixtures.content: Users can log in with their email and password.
oracle_steps: Enter valid credentials (the registered email and password)
Submit the login form
Verify a session is returned
Enter invalid credentials
Verify an error message is shown
Verify the error is identical for an unregistered email
Verify the password is masked in the login form
Verify the error does not reveal which email is registered

test_cases.title: Log in with valid credentials
steps: Open the login page
Enter valid credentials: the registered email and the correct password
Submit the login form
Verify a session is returned and the user is signed in
expected_results: The signed-in home screen is shown

test_cases.title: Log in with invalid credentials
steps: Open the login page
Enter invalid credentials: a registered email and a wrong password
Submit the login form
Verify an error message is shown and no session is returned
expected_results: The login form remains visible with the error

test_cases.title: Login errors do not reveal registered emails
steps: Attempt login with an unregistered email and any password
Attempt login with a registered email and a wrong password
Compare the two error messages
expected_results: Both attempts return the same generic error message

fixtures.title: Password reset via email
fixtures.content: Users can reset their password via a link emailed to them.
acceptance_criteria: New password must be at least 8 characters
oracle_steps: Request a password reset by email
Open the reset link from the email
Set a new password of at least 8 characters
Verify login works with the new password
Verify the reset link expires after 30 minutes
Verify a short password is rejected
Verify a used reset link cannot be reused
Verify the reset email is not sent to unregistered emails

test_cases.title: Reset the password with a fresh email link
steps: Request a password reset for the registered email
Open the reset link from the received email
Enter a new password of at least 8 characters
Confirm the new password
Verify the password is changed and login works with the new password
expected_results: Login succeeds with the new password

test_cases.title: An expired reset link is rejected
steps: Request a password reset
Wait past the 30 minute expiry of the reset link
Open the reset link
Verify the expired link is rejected
expected_results: The link is refused as expired

test_cases.title: The new password must meet the 8 character minimum
steps: Open the reset link
Enter a 7 character new password
Verify the 7 character password is rejected
Enter an 8 character new password
Verify the 8 character password is accepted
expected_results: Only the 8 character password is accepted

test_cases.title: A used reset link cannot be reused
steps: Complete a reset with the reset link
Open the same reset link again
Verify the used link is rejected
expected_results: The second use is refused

fixtures.title: Search products by name
fixtures.content: Users can search products by name.
oracle_steps: Enter a product name in the search box
Submit the search
Verify the results are sorted by relevance
Submit an empty search
Verify a message is shown for the empty search
Submit a single character search
Verify the search box is keyboard accessible
Verify a very long search term does not break the layout

test_cases.title: Search by product name returns relevant results
steps: Open the product catalog
Enter a product name in the search box
Submit the search
Verify the results are listed
Verify the results are sorted by relevance
expected_results: The matching products appear in the result list

test_cases.title: An empty search shows a friendly message
steps: Clear the search box
Submit an empty search
Verify a no-results message is shown
expected_results: The no-results message is shown instead of an error

test_cases.title: A single character search does not fail
steps: Enter a single character in the search box
Submit the search
Verify results or a no-results message are shown without an error
expected_results: The search completes without an error

test_cases.title: The search box is usable from the keyboard
steps: Focus the search box using only the keyboard
Type a product name
Press Enter to submit the search
Verify the search box has a visible label for screen readers
expected_results: The search submits and the label is announced

test_cases.title: Add an item to the cart

Select a quantity for the item
Add the item to the cart

test_cases.title: The item quantity can be changed in the cart
steps: Open the cart
Increase the item quantity
Decrease the item quantity

fixtures.title: Checkout with saved card
fixtures.content: Users can check out with a saved payment card.
oracle_steps: Select the saved card at checkout
Place the order without re-entering card details
Verify the payment is processed
Verify the saved card is masked
Verify a checkout without a saved card prompts to add one
Verify the full card number is never exposed
Verify the order total is correct for the cart
Verify no card details are re-entered during checkout

test_cases.title: Check out with a saved card without re-entering details
steps: Open the checkout
Select the saved card as the payment method
Place the order
Verify the payment is processed
Verify the order total is correct
Verify no card details are re-entered
expected_results: The order is placed and the total is unchanged

test_cases.title: A checkout without a saved card prompts to add one
steps: Open the checkout
Select the payment step
Verify the user is prompted to add a card
expected_results: An add-card prompt is shown

test_cases.title: The saved card number stays masked
steps: Open the checkout
Verify the saved card shows only the last four digits
Complete the order without typing card details
Verify the full card number is not exposed in the UI
expected_results: Only the last four digits are visible

Verify the orders are listed newest first

test_cases.title: Orders are listed newest first with status
steps: Sign in
Open the order history
Verify the orders are listed newest first
Verify each order shows its status

test_cases.title: An account without orders sees an empty state

Open the order history

test_cases.title: The history is hidden while signed out

test_cases.title: The status reflects an order that has shipped

test_cases.title: The history can be exported to a CSV report

test_cases.title: Cancel an unshipped order starts the refund
steps: Open the order details
Select the cancel option
Confirm the cancellation
Verify the cancellation is confirmed
Verify the refund is initiated
expected_results: The order shows the cancellation confirmation

test_cases.title: A shipped order cannot be cancelled

Verify the cancel option is unavailable
expected_results: No cancel option is offered

test_cases.title: Cancelling is final and the state is stable
steps: Cancel the order
Re-open the order details
Verify the status is cancelled and the refund is in progress

Verify the receipt includes the order details
Verify the receipt is sent to the registered address

Wait for the receipt email
Open the receipt

Verify the receipt shows the order number and total

test_cases.title: The receipt arrives within one minute

fixtures.title: Update user profile
fixtures.content: Users can update their profile: display name, email address, and avatar.
acceptance_criteria: Display name is at most 60 characters
Email must be unique and valid
Avatar is limited to 2 MB and image formats only
Changes are visible immediately on the profile page
oracle_steps: Sign in with a registered account
Open the profile settings page
Change the display name to a new value
Save the profile changes
Verify the display name updates on the profile page
Set the email to a value already used by another account
Verify a duplicate email error is shown and the email is unchanged
Upload a 5 MB file as the avatar
Verify the size limit error is shown
Upload a valid PNG avatar under 2 MB
Verify the new avatar is displayed

test_cases.title: Update display name and see it applied
steps: Sign in with a registered account
Open the profile settings page
Change the display name to a new value
Save the profile changes
Verify the display name updates on the profile page
expected_results: The profile page shows the new display name

test_cases.title: A duplicate email is rejected
steps: Sign in with a registered account
Open the profile settings page
Set the email to a value already used by another account
Save the profile changes
Verify a duplicate email error is shown and the email is unchanged
expected_results: The error names the duplicate email and the old email remains

test_cases.title: Avatar size limit is enforced at 2 MB
steps: Open the profile settings page
Upload a 5 MB file as the avatar
Verify the size limit error is shown
Upload a valid PNG avatar under 2 MB
Verify the new avatar is displayed
expected_results: The oversized file is rejected
The valid avatar is shown

test_cases.title: Profile updates require authentication
steps: Open the profile settings page while signed out
Verify a sign-in prompt is shown
Verify no profile data is visible before sign-in
expected_results: The profile is not editable before sign-in

fixtures.title: Upload product image
fixtures.content: Merchants can upload an image for a product from the product editor.
acceptance_criteria: Only JPG, PNG, and WEBP are accepted
Files larger than 5 MB are rejected
The image is previewed before saving
oracle_steps: Sign in with a merchant account
Open the product editor for a product
Choose a valid PNG image under 5 MB
Verify the image preview appears
Save the product
Verify the image is shown on the product page
Choose a text file as the image
Verify an unsupported format error is shown
Choose a 6 MB image file
Verify the size limit error is shown

test_cases.title: Upload a valid product image end to end
preconditions: A merchant account owns at least one product
steps: Sign in with a merchant account
Open the product editor for a product
Choose a valid PNG image under 5 MB
Verify the image preview appears
Save the product
Verify the image is shown on the product page
expected_results: The product page shows the uploaded image

test_cases.title: Unsupported file types are rejected
preconditions: A merchant account owns at least one product
steps: Open the product editor for a product
Choose a text file as the image
Verify an unsupported format error is shown
expected_results: Only JPG, PNG, and WEBP are accepted

test_cases.title: Files over 5 MB are rejected
preconditions: A merchant account owns at least one product
steps: Open the product editor for a product
Choose a 6 MB image file
Verify the size limit error is shown
expected_results: The large file is rejected with a size error

test_cases.title: The upload is scoped to the merchant's own products
steps: Sign in with a merchant account
Open the product editor for another merchant's product
Verify access to the editor is denied
expected_results: A merchant cannot upload for products they do not own
